Packetize a schema

Source: R/packetize.R
cs_packetize.Rd

Produces one complete copy of every schema packet: the header (packet 0), one packet per field, and the table-level packet last, fragmenting any payload that would exceed the MTU. The whole-schema hash is carried in the header. Replication and striping are applied later by the layout layer.

Usage

cs_packetize(s, mtu = CS_DEFAULT_MTU, side = NULL, sidehash = NULL)

Arguments

s

An cs_schema.

mtu

Maximum packet length in characters, including braces.

side, sidehash

Optional sidecar filename/URL and its hash for the header.

Value

A character vector of packets with class cs_packets and attributes P (number of indices, including the header), mtu, and type.

Examples

cs_packetize(cs_schema(data.frame(id = 1:3, g = factor(c("a", "b", "a")))))
#> <cs_packets> 4 packets, P = 4 indices, type S , mtu 200 
#>   {{S0/4~cs=1^enc=utf-8^dialect=rfc4180^fields=2^rows=3^mtu=200^hash=c30e22ef858b~0f5d9da6}}
#>   {{S1/4~id^int~6ef9ac61}}
#>   {{S2/4~g^str^lev=a!b~ac1c4c6f}}
#>   {{S3/4~~6489bb58}}
